Somewhere in the middle of the Early Sakura\nShrine...\nIt has to be this old tree.
The flowers on this big cherry blossom tree are\nthe first to bloom in this area...\nI used to walk Hayatemaru here.
Hmm, this scent makes me feel nostalgic somehow...
You really love cherry blossoms, don't you!
Tee-hee, I can't believe I didn't notice how much\nyou loved them...\nI'm such a bad owner...
Anyway, I'll take this cherry blossom branch home\nto lift Hayatemaru's spirits!
W-w-what's happening?!\nI-is it an earthquake?!
Oh, look who's here!\nSo you're the female leader of Leafy Sakura\nVillage?
I-it's the oni that's been terrorizing\nthis area...the Ghostfire Oni!
Should I fill my belly with this girl's flesh,\nor use her to threaten the Leafy Sakura Clan...\nHm, I'll head back and take my time to decide.
Aaahhhhh!!
Princess Nanaka was here?
Woof!
I don't see her here now~.\nI don't think we've missed each other on our way\nthough.
Hey, are these guys the pursuers sent by the\nLeafy Sakura Clan?
Boss said there'd be a lot of 'em.\nTurns out it's just a few pathetic losers.
We could finish these guys off on our own, don't\nyou think?\nBoss is gonna be happy with us!
Excuse me?\nWho exactly is your boss?
What?\nYou dunno our boss, the Ghostfire Oni?!\nAre you serious?!
Tch, what an ignorant yokel!
Just hearing the name of the great oni,\nGhostfire Oni, is enough to make the Leafy Sakura\nClan and the Black Peach Clan tremble, you know!
The Leafy Sakura Clan~?\nYou seem to know where Princess Nanaka is,\ndon't you~?
Princess Nanaka?\nOh, you mean that foolish girl who was caught by\nour boss?
Gahahaha! I bet she was roasted alive.\nShe's probably already in our boss's belly by now.
Whaaaat~?!
Bow-wow!!\nGrrr-grrr-grrr-grrr!!
Hey, stop growling and trying to act tough when\nyou're literally shaking behind us!
Yip~...
Gahaha! What's this stupid dog doing here?!
Hmph!\nYou're just a lowly dog! Don't even think about\nbaring your fangs at oni like us!
Yelp! Yelp! Yelp!
Ugh...\nHe’s such a hopeless dog…
Hey!\nIf you don't wanna get hurt, you'd better...
Huh?\nIs something wrong?
Nah, that one over there is probably pretty tough.\nI've got a knack for sniffing out the strong ones.
Tch, you're pathetic...But, I guess that's just\nthe fate of those who always end up defeated.\nHonestly, I can kinda relate to that...
Hmph, looks like you can feel the true strength of\nthe adventurer I've trained.\nBetter give up now while I'm still being nice~!
Tch!\nC'mon, we need to get back to boss now!
O-okay!
Hey, wait! Don't even think about running!
What?
Ah, that's smart!\nSo we just follow them because they'll lead us\nstraight to Princess Nanaka~!
You just stay here and get some rest!\nYou've done a great job getting us this far!
Yip yip~...
You really love cherry blossoms, don't you!
Awooo!!!
What? Something wrong~?
Wait, what?!\nWhat's gotten into Hayatemaru?!\nSince when could he run that fast?!
W-what was that?!
I-I couldn't see anything!\nIt just felt like a gust of wind passed by!
